args.title: Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337
args.body:
## Summary

Upgrades `fastjson` from `2.8.0` to `2.9.4` in `requirements.txt`.

## Why

`fastjson` 2.8.0 is affected by [CVE-2026-31337](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-31337) (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays. The vulnerability affects versions `<2.9.4` (and `>=3.0.0 <3.1.0`); it is fixed in `2.9.4`.

## Testing

CI passed on branch `fix/fastjson-2.9.4` (run `ci-0001`).

## Notes

- No other dependencies changed.
- `requests` remains pinned at `2.32.3`.
